11:29.text: And O my people, I ask not of you for it any wealth. My reward is not but from Allāh. And I am not one to drive away those who have believed. Indeed, they will meet their Lord, but I see that you are a people behaving ignorantly.

11:30.text: And O my people, who would protect me from Allāh if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded?

11:31.text: And I do not tell you that I have the depositories

of Allāh or that I know the unseen, nor do I tell you that I am an angel, nor do I say of those upon whom your eyes look down that Allāh will never grant them any good. Allāh is most knowing of what is within their souls. Indeed, I would then be among the wrongdoers

11:32.text: They said, "O Noah, you have disputed
us and been frequent in dispute of us. So bring us what you threaten us, if you should be of the truthful."

11:34.text: And my advice will not benefit you - although I wished to advise you - if Allāh should intend to put you in error. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned."
